opening.argument: The presentation makes a concrete promise: members’ OneCoin balances will double on October 1, 2016. It uses that promised increase to promote participation and direct viewers toward account signup and further involvement, asking them to leave account information in the comment box. The earning structure is also tied to recruitment: the speaker describes supporting leaders and top-line members, while the dashboard displays leadership rank, directly sponsored members, and account splits. Together, these facts establish a scam pitch built around promised coin appreciation and recruitment-linked participation, rather than neutral financial education or market commentary.
